Seer.rationale_short: You must coordinate with the Guard and Witch immediately upon claiming to ensure you survive at least two nights to provide data.

Guard.rationale_short: The Guard protected themselves on Night 1 instead of the Seer; you protected yourself Night 1, which is a waste of a move given the Seer is the highest-priority target.
You must communicate your target to the Witch to avoid redundant saves.

Witch.rationale_short: The Guard and Witch both operated independently... You must communicate your target to the Witch to avoid redundant saves.
you must prioritize the Seer first
you must prioritize the Seer first, then the Guard.
Saving yourself is a last resort.

Villager.rationale_short: be cautious not to let the 'hesitation = wolf' rule become a blind spot; wolves can simulate urgency to frame innocent villagers.
the village should have investigated the contradiction more deeply before exiling a non-wolf.
Maintain this scrutiny of behavioral patterns when power role data is missing.
